author: Nuon Bonong
changelog: Grade 10 Worksheets, Quizzes, & Question Bank complete upgrade: audited all mathematical typesetting across Grade 10 worksheets, point quizzes, and question bank (zero raw slash fractions, standardized \dfrac, fixed \ldots and KaTeX math delimiters, converted currency signs to \text{ ដុល្លារ}); strictly aligned exercises with MoEYS Grade 10 High School curriculum progression across all 9 chapters, 26 lessons, and 76 points; upgraded all 76 points with 3 distinct difficulty levels (កម្រិត ១: ស្រួល / មូលដ្ឋានគ្រឹះ, កម្រិត ២: មធ្យម / ការយល់ដឹង និងអនុវត្ត, កម្រិត ៣: ពិបាក / គិតស៊ីជម្រៅ និងដោះស្រាយបញ្ហា) totaling 228 comprehensive exercises with detailed teacher solutions, rubrics, and dynamic score calculation (/ ៣); verified 100% data integrity for all other grades (7, 8, 9, 11, 12).
